meta.title: OpenColibri · Open source e-commerce, maintained together
meta.description: OpenColibri hosts open source e-commerce plugins and tools maintained by the community and backed by partners from the Sylius and Symfony ecosystem.

announce.textHtml: Plugins, tools, themes: OpenColibri is built together. Join us.

hero.title: Open source e‑commerce, maintained together.
hero.leadHtml: OpenColibri hosts e‑commerce plugins and tools maintained by the community, around Sylius and Symfony. No project depends on a single person or a single company, so you can build on them with confidence.

why.title: Why maintain together
why.intro: An e‑commerce plugin often rests on a single person or a single agency. When they move on, the stores that depend on it are left without updates.
aloneItems: Maintained by a single person or a single company
Abandoned when its author's priorities change
Technical choices that depend on one player
sharedItems: Maintained by several partners and contributors
Hosted by a neutral organization: it outlives any single maintainer
Under an open licence, free for anyone to use and change
Shared rules for quality, tests and documentation

projects.title: The projects
projects.intro: Colibri Starter is the first project of the organization. More plugins and tools will join it.

featured.title: Colibri Starter
featured.p: Creates a complete Sylius store in one command, then adds or removes plugins, themes and features as your needs change. The project stays standard: any Symfony team can take it over.

devKit.title: The dev-kit
devKit.p: Describe your shop in a single file, starter.yaml: catalog, theme, languages, currencies, plugins. castor dev-kit:apply changes only what differs, after showing you the plan. Drive it from an admin or from the terminal.
devKit.altAdmin: The storefront page of the dev-kit admin, with the plan of a header change
devKit.alt: The dev-kit in the terminal: a card per setting, with the plan of the changes next to it

projects.packagesTitle: Its building blocks, usable on their own

packages.name: starter-skeleton
packages.p: Starts a new Sylius project, ready to develop, in one command.

packages.name: starter-core
packages.p: The core: Sylius Docker service, installer and the extension points of the other packages.

packages.name: starter-plugins
packages.p: Adds and removes Sylius plugins, configuration and migrations included.

packages.name: starter-themes
packages.p: 21 ready-to-use storefront themes, in light and dark.

packages.name: starter-import
packages.p: Imports the catalog of an existing store, with optional AI enrichment.

packages.name: starter-datasets
packages.p: Demo catalogs ready to import, images included.

packages.name: starter-menu
packages.p: Hides the admin menu items you don't need.

packages.name: starter-upsun
packages.p: Sets up, checks and deploys a Sylius application on Upsun.

principles.title: Our principles
principles.intro: Every project hosted by OpenColibri commits to the same rules.

cards.title: Open licence
cards.p: Projects are MIT licensed: use, change and redistribute them freely, including for your clients.

cards.title: Shared maintenance
cards.p: A project has several maintainers from different companies. One of them leaving does not stop the project.

cards.title: A common organization
cards.p: Repositories belong to OpenColibri, not to an agency. Important decisions are made together.

cards.title: Shared standards
cards.p: Tests, continuous integration, documentation and accessibility: every project follows the same rules before it is released.

contribute.title: Join OpenColibri
contribute.leadHtml: You maintain a plugin, build a tool, or simply want to help? There is room for you.

ways.html: Contribute to existing projects: issues, pull requests, documentation, translations.
Propose a project: hand your plugin or tool over to the organization so that it is maintained together.
Become a partner: your company commits to maintaining projects alongside the other partners.
